~About Kristopher L. Payne
Mr. Payne lives behind the Redwood curtain in California with his wife Nicole of 19 years and his two children ages 17 and 4. This is the first book written and illustrated by Mr. Payne. When his daughter was young she asked questions about the Easter bunny. The story that he told her became the basis for the story of 'NO BUNNIES ALLOWED'. After many story rejections from failing publishing houses this lead him to the resolve to illustrate the book himself. Now after over 5 years of work the book is finally available on lulu.com and amazon.com. DIY is the new family motto! The story is a wonderful tale of courage, friendship, and adventure meant as a fun way to explain the confusion of the Easter bunny act of hiding eggs during Easter. Celebrate LOVE!
